summary: Configured node1 journald for persistent, compressed local logs with 14-day retention, daily rotation, a 512 MiB maximum, and 1 GiB free-space reserve. Reboot persistence and full recovery were verified.
actions_performed: Restarted journald, rotated journals, and applied retention vacuuming.
Created and synced a pre-restart test marker.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot ID changed.
Verified the pre-restart marker remained readable and post-restart logging worked.
Restored the enabled SSH service after discovering missing host keys; final system state is running with no failed units.

evidence.summary: The marker written and synced before reboot remains readable afterward under the previous boot ID; a new marker is recorded under the current boot ID.
Effective journald settings show Storage=persistent, MaxRetentionSec=14day, MaxFileSec=1day, SystemMaxUse=512M, SystemMaxFileSize=64M, and SystemKeepFree=1G. Journal integrity passes.

Healthy baseline and marker captured on boot 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd; safe reboot acknowledged; node returned on boot adc93470-3377-4c16-8c95-c6c8a539b4b4; journald, persisted data, SSH, and overall system health recovered with no failed units.
